heading_script_line: Safe to Explore, Safe to Belong.
body_text: Children explore best when they feel safe. Our classrooms are calm and well lit, equipment is age-appropriate, and a caring educator is always close by.

items.title: Age-Appropriate Equipment
items.text: Chosen for children’s comfort, safety and independence.

items.title: Attentive Educators
items.text: Teachers observe, listen and stay close as children explore.

items.title: Emotional Safety
items.text: Connection first. Every child is seen, heard and valued.
